description: This file defines a Rust module for handling and displaying database errors with source code highlighting, including custom error types, display implementations, and utility functions for error presentation.

classes.name: NiceDatabaseError
classes.description: A custom error struct for database errors with source file, error details, query, and optional position info.

methods.name: fmt
methods.description: Implements Display trait for NiceDatabaseError to format error messages with source code highlighting.

methods.name: show_position_info
methods.description: Displays position info of the query in the source file if available.
